CHAPTER.VERS: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in Yahweh Are as mount Zion, which can't be moved, but remains forever.
As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So Yahweh is round about his people From this time forth and forevermore.
For the scepter of wickedness will not rest on the lot of the righteous; That the righteous don't put forth their hands to iniquity.
Do good, O Yahweh, to those who are good, And to those who are upright in their hearts.
But as for such as turn aside to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.
